coverageNotes: September 2026 import-price observations were scheduled to publish on 2026-10-15, after the 2026-10-14 evidence cutoff; August 2026 is the latest available IPI vintage used. Official FSO 2026 release calendar (source FSO_IPI_RELEASE_SCHEDULE_2026, p.2) lists 15 October.

Public sources located provide aggregate Q2 current-account net balance and gross merchanting sales, plus only qualitative y/y direction for the merchanting balance. Merchanting-only net amount and firm finance/hedge books remain unobserved.
September CPI release supplies headline and qualitative price component directions; it does not provide a quantitative imported-goods-only CPI contribution in the located release text.
No 2015 event coefficient is carried into a present GDP forecast; no bilateral CHF or market-access causal effect is estimated.
